orgs.name: AI Startup
orgs.tagline: An open-source startup operating school for technical founders — functional curricula × role pathways × startup stages.
orgs.overview: This org covers **turning it into a company** — the operating knowledge technical founders need: how startups work as a system, customer discovery and product-market fit, go-to-market, finance and fundraising, operations and governance, and the endgame. Each curriculum is one self-contained repository, and you learn by building real **founder artifacts**, not reading case studies.

roles.title: Startup Foundations
roles.focus: How startups work as a system, the dependency graph, stages, founder operating basics, reading the numbers

roles.title: Founder / CEO
roles.focus: Customer discovery, business modeling, runway, pre-seed to seed fundraising, SAFEs & cap tables, founder-led sales

roles.title: Co-Founder / CTO
roles.focus: Architecture under uncertainty, build vs. buy, first engineering hires, tech debt as a business decision, scaling

roles.title: Startup Product & GTM
roles.focus: Problem validation, PMF signals, positioning, ICP, founder-led sales, pricing & packaging, demand generation

roles.title: Founding CPO / Head of Product
roles.focus: Discovery to PMF, prioritization, outcome roadmaps, discovery/delivery cadence, experimentation & AI evals

roles.title: Startup Finance & Fundraising
roles.focus: Startup accounting, unit economics, three-statement forecasting, cap tables, convertibles, valuation, fundraising

roles.title: Startup Operations & Governance
roles.focus: Entity formation, founder legal architecture, employment law, HR ops, equity-comp policy, compensation

roles.title: Startup Exit & Endgame
roles.focus: Endgame strategy, M&A structures & acquirer motivations, LOIs, diligence & data rooms, secondaries

orgs.name: AI Governance
orgs.tagline: A hands-on, role-based curriculum for governing, securing, and assuring AI — from analyst to Chief AI Officer.
orgs.overview: This org covers **AI governance** — *governing, securing and assuring* AI: inventories and risk assessments, red-teaming and adversarial ML, release assurance and evaluation evidence, ML security, agentic safety, enterprise control architecture, and executive leadership of an AI governance program. Every role track has a paired **learning** repository and a **solutions** repository with reference walkthroughs.

roles.title: AI Governance Analyst
roles.focus: AI inventory & intake, risk assessments, fairness review, impact assessments & model cards, regulatory tracking

roles.title: AI Risk Engineer
roles.focus: Risk frameworks, harm modeling, risk registers, LLM red-teaming, adversarial ML, fairness, privacy risk

roles.title: AI Evaluation Engineer
roles.focus: Release assurance, assurance cases, release gates, evaluation evidence pipelines, cross-jurisdiction obligations

roles.title: AI/ML Security & Governance Engineer
roles.focus: ML security, zero trust, secrets, adversarial ML, runtime security, policy as code, supply chain, SecOps

roles.title: Agentic Safety & Red-Team Engineer
roles.focus: Agent threat modeling, prompt injection & jailbreaks, dangerous-capability evals, excessive-agency containment

roles.title: Senior AI Governance / Risk Architect
roles.focus: AI control libraries, policy as code, multi-jurisdiction reconciliation, AI management systems, risk appetite

roles.title: Head of AI Governance
roles.focus: Running the program, board & audit reporting, regulator engagement, regulatory change, program maturity

roles.title: Chief AI Officer
roles.focus: AI regulation & risk, model risk management, responsible AI, AI security, audit evidence, board reporting

orgs.name: AI Engineering
orgs.tagline: A hands-on, role-based curriculum for engineers who build with AI — LLM apps, RAG, agents, and multi-agent systems, from first app to systems architect.
orgs.overview: This org covers **AI engineering** — *building with* the models: LLM application development, retrieval and RAG, agents and multi-agent systems, evaluation, guardrails, harness engineering, and production operations. Every role track has a paired **learning** repository (modules, lecture chapters, exercises, quizzes) and a **solutions** repository with reference walkthroughs.

roles.title: Agentic AI Developer
roles.focus: LLM fundamentals, prompting & structured output, tool calling, retrieval basics, first agent, shipping

roles.title: LLM Application Developer
roles.focus: Prompting, tool calling, streaming & async, model selection, prompt caching, retrieval, minimal evals

roles.title: AI Evaluation Engineer
roles.focus: Trace instrumentation, trajectory & tool evals, LLM-as-judge, RAG evals, eval-gated CI/CD, online evals

roles.title: Agentic AI Engineer
roles.focus: Agent loop, frameworks, RAG & memory, multi-agent, evals, guardrails, production, harness engineering

roles.title: Applied AI Engineer
roles.focus: AI feature design, production prompting, RAG in product, orchestration, product agents, guardrails

roles.title: RAG & Retrieval Engineer
roles.focus: Ingestion & chunking, embeddings, vector DBs & ANN tuning, learning-to-rank, hybrid retrieval, reranking

roles.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
roles.focus: Customer discovery, integrating into enterprise stacks, evals on customer data, demo→production, field feedback loops

roles.title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer
roles.focus: Agent systems from an architecture, eval & observability infra, multi-agent at scale, reliability, cost

roles.title: Agentic Systems Architect
roles.focus: When not to use an agent, orchestration & memory architecture, eval harnesses, security, durable execution

orgs.name: ML Engineering
orgs.tagline: A hands-on, role-based curriculum for engineers who build and train machine-learning models — from your first production model to principal-level ML strategy.
orgs.overview: This org covers **ML engineering** — *building and training* the models: data pipelines, classical and deep learning, fine-tuning and alignment, evaluation, distributed training, and the senior-to-principal work of setting ML architecture and strategy. Every role track has a paired **learning** repository (modules, lecture chapters, exercises) and a **solutions** repository with reference walkthroughs.

roles.title: Machine Learning Engineer
roles.focus: ML foundations, data for ML, classical & deep learning, experiment tracking, deployment, drift monitoring

roles.title: Fine-Tuning Engineer
roles.focus: SFT data, PEFT (LoRA/QLoRA), preference optimization, safety tuning, distributed fine-tuning, quantization

roles.title: Model Evaluation Engineer
roles.focus: Benchmarks, LLM eval harnesses, LLM-as-judge, human eval, agent & safety evals, production eval

roles.title: NLP Engineer
roles.focus: Tokenization, classical NLP, classification, extraction, QA, summarization, machine translation

roles.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
roles.focus: ML systems architecture, production LLM integration, experimentation at scale, ML SLOs, technical leadership

roles.title: Training Pipeline Engineer
roles.focus: Distributed training, data pipelines at scale, cluster orchestration, checkpointing, elastic training, throughput

roles.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
roles.focus: Multi-team ML architecture, foundation-model training programs, ML platform strategy, capacity & TCO

roles.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
roles.focus: Org & industry ML strategy, north-star ML architecture, influence without authority, the technical bar

orgs.name: AI Infrastructure
orgs.verb: Run the platforms models live on
orgs.tagline: A comprehensive, hands-on learning path for AI Infrastructure Engineers — from entry level to principal.
orgs.overview: This org covers **AI infrastructure** — *running* the platforms: foundational Python and Kubernetes through distributed training, GPU and LLM infrastructure, MLOps, platform engineering, performance, and enterprise architecture. Every role track has a paired **learning** repository (modules, lecture chapters, exercises, quizzes) and a **solutions** repository with reference walkthroughs.

roles.title: Junior AI Infrastructure Engineer
roles.focus: Python & ML basics, Linux & Docker, Kubernetes intro, cloud platforms, monitoring

roles.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
roles.focus: Production ML, distributed training, GPU computing, advanced Kubernetes, MLOps, LLM infra, IaC

roles.title: AI/ML Platform Engineer
roles.focus: Platform architecture, multi-tenancy, serving at scale, platform APIs/SDKs, developer experience

roles.title: MLOps Engineer
roles.focus: CI/CD for ML, model registry, feature stores, experiment tracking, drift detection, A/B testing

roles.title: Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer
roles.focus: Advanced Kubernetes (operators/CRDs), distributed training at scale, CUDA, multi-cloud, SRE

roles.title: AI Inference Engineer
roles.focus: Serving engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang), batching & KV cache, quantization, routing, GPU autoscaling, latency/cost SLOs

roles.title: AI Infrastructure Performance Engineer
roles.focus: GPU utilization, inference latency, training efficiency, cost optimization, profiling

roles.title: AI Infrastructure Team Lead
roles.focus: Technical strategy & roadmaps, team building, ADRs, incident & performance management

roles.title: AI Infrastructure Architect
roles.focus: Enterprise ML architecture, multi-cloud/hybrid, security & compliance, FinOps, HA/DR, LLM/RAG platforms

roles.title: Principal AI Infrastructure Engineer
roles.focus: Deep technical expertise, extreme-scale distributed systems, novel infra solutions, mentorship

roles.title: Senior AI Infrastructure Architect
roles.focus: Cross-org architecture alignment, enterprise standards, multi-year roadmaps, executive communication

roles.title: Principal AI Infrastructure Architect
roles.focus: Company-wide strategy, multi-year roadmaps, technology selection, architecture governance
